title.zh: 卷十 本紀第十 順帝
title.raw: 卷十 本紀第十 順帝 Volume 10 Annals 10: Emperor Shun

sentences.zh: 順皇帝諱準，字仲謀，[1]小字智觀，明帝第三子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Shun, taboo name Zhun, courtesy name Zhongmou, [1] childhood name Zhiguan, was the third son of Emperor Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shun, taboo name Zhun, courtesy name Zhongmou, [1] childhood name Zhiguan, was the third son of Emperor Ming.

sentences.zh: 泰始五年七月癸丑生。

translations.literal: He was born on the guichou day of the seventh month of the fifth year of Taishi.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on the guichou day of the seventh month of the fifth year of Taishi.

sentences.zh: 七年，封安成王，食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng with a fief of three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was created Prince of Ancheng with a fief of three thousand households.

sentences.zh: 仍拜撫軍將軍，置佐史。

translations.literal: He was at once appointed General Who Pacifies the Army, with aides and clerks established.
translations.idiomatic: He was at once appointed General Who Pacifies the Army, with aides and clerks assigned.

sentences.zh: 廢帝即位，為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: When the Deposed Emperor acceded, he became Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor acceded, he became Inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 元徽二年，進號車騎將軍、都督揚南豫二州諸軍事，給鼓吹一部，刺史如故。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanhui he was advanced to General of Chariots and Cavalry and Commander-in-Chief of all military affairs in Yang, South Yu, and Xu provinces, granted one set of martial pipes and drums, and remained Inspector as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanhui he was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry and Commander-in-Chief of all military affairs in Yang, South Yu, and Xu provinces, granted one set of martial pipes and drums, and remained Inspector as before.

sentences.zh: 四年，又進號驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，班劍三十人，都督、刺史如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was further advanced to Grand General of Agile Cavalry with the Baimen of the Three Ministries, thirty ceremonial swords, and remained Commander-in-Chief and Inspector as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was further promoted to Grand General of Agile Cavalry with Baimen equal to the Three Ministries, thirty ceremonial swords, and remained Commander-in-Chief and Inspector as before.

sentences.zh: 元徽五年七月戊子夜，廢帝殞，奉迎王入居朝堂。

translations.literal: On the night of the wuzi day of the seventh month of the fifth year of Yuanhui, the Deposed Emperor died; the king was welcomed and entered to dwell in the court hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the wuzi day of the seventh month of the fifth year of Yuanhui, the Deposed Emperor died; the prince was escorted into the court hall.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the renchen day he assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day he ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 昇明元年，改元，大赦天下，賜文武位二等。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shengming the era name was changed, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted two ranks in status.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shengming the era name was changed, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were advanced two ranks in status.

sentences.zh: 甲午，鎮軍將軍齊王出鎮東城，輔政作相。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day the Prince of Qi, General Who Pacifies the Army, went out to garrison the Eastern Fortress and served as regent and chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the Prince of Qi, General Who Pacifies the Army, went out to garrison the Eastern Fortress and took up regency as chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「露臺息構，義光漢德；

translations.literal: On the bingyin day an edict said: "Ceasing construction on the Terrace of Dew shed light on Han virtue;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day an edict said: "Ceasing construction on the Terrace of Dew shed light on Han virtue;

sentences.zh: 雉裘焚制，事隆晉道。

translations.literal: burning the pheasant-fur robe exalted the way of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: burning the pheasant-fur robe exalted the way of Jin.

sentences.zh: 故以檢奢軌化，敦儉馭俗。

translations.literal: Thus extravagance is checked to transform customs, and thrift is honored to govern the people.
translations.idiomatic: Thus extravagance is checked to transform customs, and thrift is honored to govern the people.

sentences.zh: 頃甸服未靜，師旅連年，委蓄屢空，勞敝莫偃。

translations.literal: Recently the imperial domain has not been tranquil; armies have campaigned year after year; stored supplies are repeatedly depleted and toil and exhaustion never ease.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the realm has not been at peace; armies have campaigned year after year; granaries stand empty again and again, and exhaustion never lets up.

sentences.zh: 而丹雘之飾，糜耗難訾，寶賂之費，徵賦靡計。

translations.literal: Yet vermilion and cinnabar ornament wastes beyond reckoning, and treasure outlays for tribute levies cannot be calculated.
translations.idiomatic: Yet lacquer and cinnabar ornament consume resources beyond measure, and treasure levies cannot be reckoned.

sentences.zh: 今車服儀制，實宜約損，使徽章有序，勿得侈溢。

translations.literal: Now carriage robes and ritual regalia truly ought to be reduced in scale, so that emblems and insignia keep their order and excess not be allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Carriage dress and ritual regalia should now be pared back, so that ranks and insignia stay in order and excess is not permitted.

sentences.zh: 可罷省御府二署。

translations.literal: The two bureaus of the Inner Palace may be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The two bureaus of the Inner Palace are to be abolished.

sentences.zh: 凡工麗彫鑴，傷風毀治，一皆禁斷。

translations.literal: All ingenious carving and fine chasing that harm customs and ruin governance—every one is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Every sort of ornate carving and fine chasing that harms custom and undermines good government is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 庶永昭憲則，弘茲始政。

translations.literal: Thus may the canonical law shine forever and this inaugural governance be enlarged."
translations.idiomatic: May the statutes shine forever and this new rule be broadly proclaimed."

sentences.zh: 」征西大將軍、荊州刺史沈攸之進號車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，尚書左僕射、中領軍、鎮軍將軍、南兗州刺史齊王為司空、錄尚書事、驃騎大將軍，刺史如故，中書令、衞將軍、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍劉秉為尚書令，加中軍將軍，[2]安西將軍、郢州刺史晉熙王燮為撫軍將軍、揚州刺史，南陽王翽為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: The General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Jingzhou Shen Youzhi was advanced to General of Chariots and Cavalry with Baimen equal to the Three Ministries; the Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Central Army Commander, General Who Pacifies the Army, and Inspector of South Yanzhou, the Prince of Qi, was made Minister of Works, Recording Secretary, and Grand General of Agile Cavalry, remaining Inspector as before; Master of Writing, Guards General, Baimen equal to the Three Ministries; the General Who Pacifies the Army Liu Bing was made Director of the Masters of Writing and additionally Central Army Commander; [2] the General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou, Prince of Jinxi Xie, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yangzhou; the Prince of Nanyang Hui was made Inspector of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Youzhi, General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Jingzhou, was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry with Baimen equal to the Three Ministries; the Prince of Qi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Central Army Commander, General Who Pacifies the Army, and Inspector of South Yanzhou, was appointed Minister of Works, Recording Secretary, and Grand General of Agile Cavalry, remaining Inspector as before; Master of Writing, Guards General, Baimen equal to the Three Ministries; Liu Bing, General Who Pacifies the Army, was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing and additionally Central Army Commander; [2] Xie, Prince of Jinxi, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yangzhou; Prince of Nanyang Hui was appointed Inspector of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，尚書右僕射王僧虔為尚書僕射，右衞將軍劉韞為中領軍，金紫光祿大夫王琨為右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day the Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Sengqian was made Director of the Masters of Writing; the Right Guards General Liu Yun was made Central Army Commander; the Grandee of Splendid Gold and Purple Guanglu Wang Kun was made Right Grandee of Splendid Service.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Wang Sengqian, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing; Liu Yun, Right Guards General, was appointed Central Army Commander; Wang Kun, Grandee of Splendid Gold and Purple Guanglu, was appointed Right Grandee of Splendid Service.

sentences.zh: 給司空齊王錢五百萬，布五千匹。

translations.literal: Five million cash and five thousand bolts of cloth were granted to the Prince of Qi, Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Five million cash and five thousand bolts of cloth were granted to the Prince of Qi, Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，車駕謁太廟。

translations.literal: On the guimao day the imperial carriage visited the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the emperor visited the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以安西參軍明慶符為青、冀二州刺史，武陵王贊為郢州刺史，新除郢州刺史南陽王翽為湘州刺史，司空、南兗州刺史齊王改領南徐州刺史，征虜將軍李安民為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day the Anxi staff officer Ming Qingfu was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces; the Prince of Wuling Zan was made Inspector of Yingzhou; the newly appointed Inspector of Yingzhou, Prince of Nanyang Hui, was made Inspector of Xiangzhou; the Prince of Qi, Minister of Works and Inspector of South Yanzhou, was changed to hold concurrently the post of Inspector of South Xuzhou; Li Anmin, General Who Conquers the Barbarians, was made Inspector of South Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Ming Qingfu, staff officer of Anxi, was appointed Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces; Prince of Wuling Zan was appointed Inspector of Yingzhou; Prince of Nanyang Hui, newly appointed Inspector of Yingzhou, was appointed Inspector of Xiangzhou; the Prince of Qi, Minister of Works and Inspector of South Yanzhou, was reassigned to hold concurrently Inspector of South Xuzhou; Li Anmin, General Who Conquers the Barbarians, was appointed Inspector of South Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，詔曰：「昔聖王既沒，淳風已衰，龜書永湮，龍圖長祕。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the ninth month an edict said: "When the sage kings passed away, pure custom already declined; the Tortoise Book was forever submerged and the Dragon Chart long concealed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the ninth month an edict said: "When the sage kings passed away, pure custom had already decayed; the Tortoise Book lay forever hidden and the Dragon Chart long sealed away.

sentences.zh: 故三代之末，德刑相擾，世淪物競，道陂人諛。

translations.literal: Thus at the end of the Three Dynasties, virtue and punishment mutually encroached; the age sank into wrangling over things, the Way broke down and men flattered.
translations.idiomatic: Thus at the end of the Three Dynasties virtue and punishment encroached on one another; the age sank into contention over things, the Way collapsed, and men traded in flattery.

sentences.zh: 然猶正士比轂，奇才接軫。

translations.literal: Yet upright gentlemen were still numerous as wagon hubs, and extraordinary talents followed in unbroken succession.
translations.idiomatic: Yet upright gentlemen still thronged like spokes at a hub, and extraordinary talents came one after another.

sentences.zh: 朕襲運金樞，纂靈瑤極，負扆巡政，日晏忘疲，永言興替，望古盈慮。

translations.literal: We have inherited the golden pivot of fortune and received the jade pole of numinous mandate; bearing the screen at court we govern without rest, forgetting weariness at day's end, ever speaking of rise and fall, looking to antiquity with full concern.
translations.idiomatic: We have inherited the golden pivot of the age and received the jade axis of the mandate; seated behind the screen we govern without rest, forgetting fatigue at day's end, ever pondering rise and fall and looking to antiquity with full concern.

sentences.zh: 姬、夏典載，猶傳緗帙，漢、魏餘文，布在方冊。

translations.literal: The archives of Zhou and Xia are still preserved in silk volumes; remaining writings of Han and Wei are spread among the registers.
translations.idiomatic: The records of Zhou and Xia still survive in silk volumes; the remaining writings of Han and Wei lie spread among the registers.

sentences.zh: 故元封興茂才之制，地節剏獨行之品。

translations.literal: Therefore in the Yuanshou era the institution for eminent talent was raised, and in the Dijie era the rank for lone excellence was created.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore in the Yuanshou era the eminent-talent institution was established, and in the Dijie era the rank for lone excellence was created.

sentences.zh: 振維務本，存乎得人。

translations.literal: To brace the cords and hold fast to the root lies in obtaining men.
translations.idiomatic: To brace the framework and hold to the root lies in finding the right men.

sentences.zh: 今可宣下州郡，搜揚幽仄，摽采鄉邑，隨名薦上。

translations.literal: Now this may be proclaimed to the provinces and commanderies: search out the hidden and remote, take specimens from villages and hamlets, and recommend by name to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Let this now be proclaimed through the provinces and commanderies: search out the hidden and remote, gather talent from villages and hamlets, and recommend them by name to the throne.

sentences.zh: 朕將親覽，甄其茂異。

translations.literal: We shall personally review them and distinguish their outstanding excellence.
translations.idiomatic: We shall personally examine them and distinguish the truly outstanding.

sentences.zh: 庶野無遺彥，永激遐芬。

translations.literal: Thus no worthy shall be left in the wilds, and distant fragrance shall be stirred forever."
translations.idiomatic: Thus no worthy shall be left in obscurity, and distant virtue shall be stirred forever."

sentences.zh: 」己酉，廬陵王暠薨。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day Prince of Luling Hao died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Prince of Luling Hao died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己酉，[4]倭國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In winter, on the jiyou day of the eleventh month, [4] Wa sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the jiyou day of the eleventh month, [4] Wa sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 丙午，員外散騎侍郎胡羨生行越州刺史，以交州刺史沈景德為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day the Supernumerary Palace Attendant Hu Xiansheng acted as Inspector of Yuezhou, and Shen Jingde, Inspector of Jiaozhou, was made Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Hu Xiansheng, Supernumerary Palace Attendant, was dispatched as Inspector of Yuezhou, and Shen Jingde, Inspector of Jiaozhou, was appointed Inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，以驍騎將軍王廣之為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month Wang Guangzhi, General of Agile Cavalry, was made Inspector of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month Wang Guangzhi, General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 車騎大將軍、荊州刺史沈攸之舉兵反。

translations.literal: Shen Youzhi, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jingzhou, raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Youzhi, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jingzhou, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，錄公齊王入守朝堂，侍中蕭嶷鎮東府。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, entered to guard the court hall, and the Palace Attendant Xiao Luan garrisoned the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, entered to guard the court hall, and Palace Attendant Xiao Luan garrisoned the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，內外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day martial law was imposed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day martial law was imposed within and without the capital.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以郢州刺史武陵王贊為安西將軍、荊州刺史，征虜將軍、雍州刺史張敬兒進號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the jisi day the Prince of Wuling Zan, Inspector of Yingzhou, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Jingzhou; Zhang Jinger, General Who Conquers the Barbarians and Inspector of Yongzhou, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Prince of Wuling Zan, Inspector of Yingzhou, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Jingzhou; Zhang Jinger, General Who Conquers the Barbarians and Inspector of Yongzhou, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 右衞將軍黃回為平西將軍、郢州刺史，督諸軍前鋒南討。

translations.literal: Huang Hui, Right Guards General, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou, commanding the vanguard armies in the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Hui, Right Guards General, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou, commanding the vanguard in the southern expedition.

sentences.zh: 征虜將軍呂安國為湘州刺史，都官尚書王寬加平西將軍。

translations.literal: Lu Anguo, General Who Conquers the Barbarians, was made Inspector of Xiangzhou; Wang Kuan, Director of Palace Affairs, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Anguo, General Who Conquers the Barbarians, was appointed Inspector of Xiangzhou; Wang Kuan, Director of Palace Affairs, was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 庚午，新除左衞將軍齊王世子奉新除撫軍將軍、揚州刺史晉熙王燮鎮尋陽之盆城。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day the newly appointed Left Guards General, heir of the Prince of Qi, escorted the newly appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Jinxi Xie, to garrison Pencheng at Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the newly appointed Left Guards General, heir of the Prince of Qi, escorted the newly appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Jinxi Xie, to garrison Pencheng at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以驍騎將軍周盤龍為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the renshen day Zhou Panlong, General of Agile Cavalry, was made Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Zhou Panlong, General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是日，司徒袁粲據石頭反，尚書令劉秉、黃門侍郎劉述、冠軍王蘊率眾赴之。

translations.literal: That day Minister over the Masses Yuan Can held Stone City in rebellion; the Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Bing, the Gentleman Attendant of the Yellow Gate Liu Shu, and the General Who Establishes Champions Wang Yun led troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Minister over the Masses Yuan Can seized Stone City in rebellion; Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Bing, Gentleman Attendant of the Yellow Gate Liu Shu, and General Who Establishes Champions Wang Yun led troops to his side.

sentences.zh: 黃回及輔國將軍孫曇瓘、屯騎校尉王宜興、輔國將軍任候伯、左軍將軍彭文之密相響應。

translations.literal: Huang Hui and the General Who Assists the State Sun Tanxuan, Commandant of Valiant Cavalry Wang Yixing, General Who Assists the State Ren Houbo, and General of the Left Army Peng Wenzhi secretly responded in concert.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Hui, Sun Tanxuan, General Who Assists the State, Commandant of Valiant Cavalry Wang Yixing, General Who Assists the State Ren Houbo, and General of the Left Army Peng Wenzhi secretly acted in concert.

sentences.zh: 中領軍劉韞、直閤將軍卜伯興在殿內同謀。

translations.literal: Central Army Commander Liu Yun and the Direct Attendant Bo Xing plotted together inside the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Central Army Commander Liu Yun and Direct Attendant Bo Xing plotted together inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 錄公齊王誅韞等於省內。

translations.literal: The Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, executed Yun and the others inside the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, executed Yun and the others inside the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 軍主蘇烈、王天生、薛道淵、戴僧靜等陷石頭，斬粲於城內。

translations.literal: The army commanders Su Lie, Wang Tiansheng, Xue Daoyuan, Dai Sengjing, and others took Stone City and beheaded Can inside the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Army commanders Su Lie, Wang Tiansheng, Xue Daoyuan, and Dai Sengjing took Stone City and beheaded Can within the walls.

sentences.zh: 秉、述、蘊踰城走，追擒之，並伏誅。

translations.literal: Bing, Shu, and Yun fled over the wall; they were pursued and captured, and all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Bing, Shu, and Yun fled over the wall; pursued and captured, they were all executed.

sentences.zh: 其餘無所問。

translations.literal: The rest were not prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: The rest were not prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 豫州刺史劉懷珍、雍州刺史張敬兒、廣州刺史陳顯達並舉義兵。

translations.literal: Liu Huaizhen, Inspector of Yuzhou; Zhang Jinger, Inspector of Yongzhou; and Chen Xianda, Inspector of Guangzhou, all raised righteous armies.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Huaizhen, Inspector of Yuzhou; Zhang Jinger, Inspector of Yongzhou; and Chen Xianda, Inspector of Guangzhou, all raised loyal forces.

sentences.zh: 司州刺史姚道和、梁州刺史范栢年、湘州行事庾佩玉擁眾懷貳。

translations.literal: Yao Daohuo, Inspector of Sizhou; Fan Bonian, Inspector of Liangzhou; and Yu Peiyu, acting for Xiangzhou, all mustered troops with divided loyalties.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Daohuo, Inspector of Sizhou; Fan Bonian, Inspector of Liangzhou; and Yu Peiyu, acting for Xiangzhou, all raised forces with divided loyalties.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以尚書僕射王僧虔為尚書左僕射，新除中書令王延之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the yihai day Wang Sengqian, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Wang Yanzhi, newly appointed Master of Writing, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Wang Sengqian, Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Wang Yanzhi, newly appointed Master of Writing, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 吳郡太守劉遐據郡反，輔國將軍張瓌討斬之。

translations.literal: Liu Xia, Governor of Wu Commandery, held the commandery in rebellion; Zhang Gui, General Who Assists the State, attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xia, Governor of Wu Commandery, rebelled and held the commandery; Zhang Gui, General Who Assists the State, attacked and killed him.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳，屯騎校尉王宜興有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the xinsi day, Wang Yixing, Commandant of Valiant Cavalry, was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the xinsi day, Wang Yixing, Commandant of Valiant Cavalry, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，沈攸之攻圍郢城，前軍長史柳世隆固守。

translations.literal: On the guisi day Shen Youzhi attacked and besieged Yingcheng; Liu Shilong, chief clerk of the vanguard, held firm in defense.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Shen Youzhi besieged Yingcheng; Liu Shilong, chief clerk of the vanguard, held firm in defense.

sentences.zh: 攸之弟登之作亂於吳興，吳興太守沈文季討斬之。

translations.literal: Youzhi's younger brother Dengzhi made trouble in Wuxing; Shen Wenji, Governor of Wuxing, attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhi's younger brother Dengzhi rose in revolt in Wuxing; Shen Wenji, Governor of Wuxing, attacked and killed him.

sentences.zh: [5]己亥，內外戒嚴，假錄公齊王黃鉞。

translations.literal: [5] On the jihai day martial law was imposed within and without, and the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, was lent the yellow battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: [5] On the jihai day martial law was imposed within and without the capital, and the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, was granted the yellow battle-axe.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，寧朔將軍、北秦州刺史武都王楊文度進號征西將軍。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day Yang Wendu, General of Pacifying the North and Inspector of North Qinzhou, Prince of Wudu, was advanced to General Who Conquers the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Yang Wendu, General of Pacifying the North and Inspector of North Qinzhou, Prince of Wudu, was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.

sentences.zh: [6]乙巳，錄公齊王出頓新亭。

translations.literal: [6] On the yisi day the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, went out and encamped at Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: [6] On the yisi day the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, went out and encamped at Xinting.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，沈攸之遣將公孫方平據西陽，辛酉，建寧太守張謨擊破之。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year, the first month, Shen Youzhi sent the general Gongsun Fangping to hold Xiyang; on the xinyou day Zhang Mo, Governor of Jianning, attacked and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, the first month, Shen Youzhi sent the general Gongsun Fangping to hold Xiyang; on the xinyou day Zhang Mo, Governor of Jianning, attacked and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，沈攸之自郢城奔散。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day Shen Youzhi fled in rout from Yingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Shen Youzhi fled in rout from Yingcheng.

sentences.zh: 己巳，華容縣民斬送之。

translations.literal: On the jisi day the people of Huarong district beheaded him and sent his head.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the people of Huarong district killed him and sent his head.

sentences.zh: 左將軍、豫州刺史劉懷珍進號平南將軍。

translations.literal: Liu Huaizhen, General of the Left Army and Inspector of Yuzhou, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Huaizhen, General of the Left Army and Inspector of Yuzhou, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 辛未，鎮軍將軍、雍州刺史張敬兒克江陵，斬攸之子光琰，荊州平，同逆皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day Zhang Jinger, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yongzhou, took Jiangling, beheaded Youzhi's son Guangyan, pacified Jingzhou, and all fellow rebels were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Zhang Jinger, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yongzhou, took Jiangling, beheaded Youzhi's son Guangyan, pacified Jingzhou, and all fellow rebels were executed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，解嚴。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day martial law was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day martial law was lifted.

sentences.zh: 以新除侍中柳世隆為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Palace Attendant Liu Shilong was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shilong, newly appointed Palace Attendant, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 是日，錄公齊王旋鎮東府。

translations.literal: That day the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, returned to garrison the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, returned to garrison the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以江州刺史邵陵王友為安南將軍、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day the Prince of Shaoling You was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of South Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Prince of Shaoling You was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of South Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: [7]左衞將軍齊王世子為江州刺史，侍中蕭嶷為領軍，鎮軍將軍、雍州刺史張敬兒進號征西將軍，平西將軍、郢州刺史黃回進號鎮西將軍。

translations.literal: [7] The Left Guards General, heir of the Prince of Qi, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou; the Palace Attendant Xiao Luan was made Commander of the Guards; Zhang Jinger, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yongzhou, was advanced to General Who Conquers the West; Huang Hui, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: [7] The Left Guards General, heir of the Prince of Qi, was appointed Inspector of Jiangzhou; Palace Attendant Xiao Luan was appointed Commander of the Guards; Zhang Jinger, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yongzhou, was promoted to General Who Conquers the West; Huang Hui, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yingzhou, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，以尚書左僕射王僧虔為尚書令，尚書右僕射王延之為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day of the second month Wang Sengqian, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Wang Yanzhi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the second month Wang Sengqian, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing; Wang Yanzhi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 癸未，錄公齊王加授太尉，衞將軍褚淵為中書監、司空。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, was additionally invested as Grand Commandant; Chu Yuan, Guards General, was made Master of Writing and Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day the Recording Secretary, the Prince of Qi, was additionally appointed Grand Commandant; Chu Yuan, Guards General, was appointed Master of Writing and Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲申，曲赦荊州。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，撫軍將軍、揚州刺史晉熙王燮進號中軍將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day Prince of Jinxi Xie, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yangzhou, was advanced to Central Army Commander with Baimen equal to the Three Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Prince of Jinxi Xie, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yangzhou, was promoted to Central Army Commander with Baimen equal to the Three Ministries.

sentences.zh: 戊子，蠲雍州緣沔居民前被水災者租布三年。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day the grain tax and cloth levy for three years were remitted for residents along the Han in Yongzhou who had earlier suffered flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day grain tax and cloth levy were remitted for three years for residents along the Han in Yongzhou who had earlier suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，郢州刺史、新除鎮南將軍黃回為鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史，南兗州刺史李安民為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day Huang Hui, Inspector of Yingzhou and newly appointed General Who Pacifies the South, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of South Yanzhou; Li Anmin, Inspector of South Yanzhou, was made Inspector of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Huang Hui, Inspector of Yingzhou and newly appointed General Who Pacifies the South, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of South Yanzhou; Li Anmin, Inspector of South Yanzhou, was appointed Inspector of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以山陰令傅琰為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On the guisi day Fu Yan of Shanyin was made Inspector of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Fu Yan of Shanyin was appointed Inspector of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，左軍將軍彭文之有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day Peng Wenzhi, General of the Left Army, was guilty, imprisoned, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Peng Wenzhi, General of the Left Army, was found guilty, imprisoned, and died.

sentences.zh: 行湘州事任候伯殺前湘州行事庾佩玉，傳首京邑。

translations.literal: Ren Houbo, acting for Xiangzhou, killed the former Xiangzhou acting officer Yu Peiyu and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Houbo, acting for Xiangzhou, killed the former acting officer of Xiangzhou Yu Peiyu and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，以廣州刺史周盤龍為司州刺史，輔國將軍劉悛為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the third month Zhou Panlong, Inspector of Guangzhou, was made Inspector of Sizhou; Liu Jun, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the third month Zhou Panlong, Inspector of Guangzhou, was appointed Inspector of Sizhou; Liu Jun, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，給太尉齊王羽葆、鼓吹。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day the canopy of feathers and martial pipes and drums were granted to the Prince of Qi, Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the canopy of feathers and martial pipes and drums were granted to the Prince of Qi, Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，以游擊將軍垣崇祖為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the jimao day Yuan Chongzu, General of the Mobile Corps, was made Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the jimao day Yuan Chongzu, General of the Mobile Corps, was appointed Inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，新除鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史黃回有罪賜死。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day Huang Hui, newly appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of South Yanzhou, was guilty and ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Huang Hui, newly appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of South Yanzhou, was found guilty and ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 甲午，輔國將軍、淮南宣城二郡太守蕭映行南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day Xiao Ying, General Who Assists the State and Governor of Huainan and Xuancheng, acted as Inspector of South Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Xiao Ying, General Who Assists the State and Governor of Huainan and Xuancheng, acted as Inspector of South Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，倭國王武遣使獻方物，以武為安東大將軍。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the fifth month the King of Wa, Bu, sent envoys presenting local products; Bu was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the fifth month the King of Wa, Bu, sent envoys presenting tribute; Bu was created General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍、行湘州事任候伯有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Ren Houbo, General Who Assists the State and acting for Xiangzhou, was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Houbo, General Who Assists the State and acting for Xiangzhou, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，以前新會太守趙超民為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the sixth month Zhao Chaomin, former Governor of Xinping, was made Inspector of Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the sixth month Zhao Chaomin, former Governor of Xinping, was appointed Inspector of Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以輔國將軍楊文弘為北秦州刺史、武都王。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day Yang Wenhong, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of North Qinzhou and Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Yang Wenhong, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Inspector of North Qinzhou and created Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，太尉齊王表斷奇飾麗服，凡十有四條。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day of the eighth month the Prince of Qi, Grand Commandant, memorialized to forbid extravagant ornament and splendid dress, fourteen articles in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the eighth month the Prince of Qi, Grand Commandant, memorialized to forbid extravagant ornament and splendid dress, fourteen articles in all.

sentences.zh: [8]乙未，以江州刺史齊王世子為領軍將軍、撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: [8] On the yiwei day the heir of the Prince of Qi, Inspector of Jiangzhou, was made Commander of the Guards and General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: [8] On the yiwei day the heir of the Prince of Qi, Inspector of Jiangzhou, was appointed Commander of the Guards and General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以領軍蕭嶷為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day Xiao Luan, Commander of the Guards, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Xiao Luan, Commander of the Guards, was appointed Inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, the day yisi, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the ninth month, the day yisi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙午，加太尉齊王黃鉞、都督中外諸軍事、太傅，領揚州牧，劍履上殿，入朝不趨，贊拜不名。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day the Prince of Qi, Grand Commandant, was additionally granted the yellow battle-axe, made Commander-in-Chief of all military affairs within and without, and appointed Grand Preceptor, holding concurrently the governorship of Yangzhou; he was permitted sword and shoes in the palace hall, not to quicken his step on entering court, and not to have his name spoken in congratulatory address.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the Prince of Qi, Grand Commandant, was additionally granted the yellow battle-axe, made Commander-in-Chief of all military affairs within and without, and appointed Grand Preceptor, holding concurrently the governorship of Yangzhou; he was permitted sword and shoes in the palace hall, not to quicken his step on entering court, and not to have his name spoken in congratulatory address.

sentences.zh: 置左右長史、司馬、從事中郎、掾、屬各四人。

translations.literal: Left and right chief clerks, marshals, attendants, aides, and subordinates were established, four of each.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right chief clerks, marshals, attendants, aides, and subordinates were established, four of each.

sentences.zh: 中軍將軍、揚州刺史晉熙王燮為司徒。

translations.literal: Prince of Jinxi Xie, Central Army Commander and Inspector of Yangzhou, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jinxi Xie, Central Army Commander and Inspector of Yangzhou, was appointed Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 戊申，行南兗州刺史蕭映為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the wushen day Xiao Ying, acting Inspector of South Yanzhou, was made Inspector of South Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Xiao Ying, acting Inspector of South Yanzhou, was appointed Inspector of South Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，給太傅齊王三望車。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day three imperial lookout chariots were granted to the Prince of Qi, Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day three imperial lookout chariots were granted to the Prince of Qi, Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己未，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day Ruru sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Ruru sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，武陵內史張澹有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day Zhang Dan, Interior Secretary of Wuling, was guilty, imprisoned, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Zhang Dan, Interior Secretary of Wuling, was found guilty, imprisoned, and died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，寧朔將軍、淮南宣城二郡太守蕭晃為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the tenth month Xiao Huang, General of Pacifying the North and Governor of Huainan and Xuancheng, was made Inspector of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the tenth month Xiao Huang, General of Pacifying the North and Governor of Huainan and Xuancheng, was appointed Inspector of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 孫曇瓘先逃亡，己卯，擒獲，伏誅。

translations.literal: Sun Tanxuan had earlier fled; on the jimao day he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Tanxuan had earlier fled; on the jimao day he was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，立皇后謝氏，減死罪一等，五歲刑以下悉原。

translations.literal: On the renyin day Empress Xie was established; death sentences were reduced one degree, and punishments of five years or less were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Empress Xie was installed; death sentences were reduced one degree, and punishments of five years or less were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，立故武昌太守劉琨息頒為南豐縣王。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the eleventh month the son of the late Governor of Wuchang Liu Kun, Bin, was established as Prince of Nanfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the eleventh month Bin, son of the late Governor of Wuchang Liu Kun, was created Prince of Nanfeng County.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，臨澧侯劉晃謀反，晃及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On the guihai day Marquis of Linli Liu Huang plotted rebellion; Huang and his partisans were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Marquis of Linli Liu Huang plotted rebellion; Huang and his associates were all executed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，改封南陽王翽為隨郡王，改隨陽郡。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day Prince of Nanyang Hui was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Suixiang, and Suixiang Commandery was renamed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Prince of Nanyang Hui was reassigned in enfeoffment to Prince of Suixiang, and Suixiang Commandery was renamed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，皇后見于太廟。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the twelfth month the empress was presented at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the twelfth month the empress was presented at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊子，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Goguryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲辰，以江州刺史蕭嶷為鎮西將軍、荊州刺史，尚書左僕射王延之為安南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year, on the jiachen day of the first month, Xiao Luan, Inspector of Jiangzhou, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Jingzhou; Wang Yanzhi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on the jiachen day of the first month, Xiao Luan, Inspector of Jiangzhou, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Jingzhou; Wang Yanzhi, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 安西長史蕭順之為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Xiao Shunzhi, chief clerk of Anxi, was made Inspector of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Shunzhi, chief clerk of Anxi, was appointed Inspector of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太傅齊王表諸負官物質役者，悉原除。

translations.literal: On the yimao day the Prince of Qi, Grand Preceptor, memorialized that all who owed official goods or corvée labor should be wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day the Prince of Qi, Grand Preceptor, memorialized that all who owed official goods or corvée labor should be wholly remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以驍騎將軍王玄邈為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day Wang Xuanmiao, General of Agile Cavalry, was made Inspector of Liang and South Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Wang Xuanmiao, General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Inspector of Liang and South Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 領軍將軍、撫軍將軍齊王世子加尚書僕射，進號中軍大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: The heir of the Prince of Qi, Commander of the Guards and General Who Pacifies the Army, was additionally made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and advanced to Grand Central Army Commander with Baimen equal to the Three Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: The heir of the Prince of Qi, Commander of the Guards and General Who Pacifies the Army, was additionally appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and promoted to Grand Central Army Commander with Baimen equal to the Three Ministries.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，加太傅齊王前部羽葆、鼓吹。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day the front canopy of feathers and martial pipes and drums were granted to the Prince of Qi, Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the front canopy of feathers and martial pipes and drums were granted to the Prince of Qi, Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔太傅府依舊辟召。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day an edict ordered the Grand Preceptor's office to recruit as of old.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day an edict ordered the Grand Preceptor's office to recruit staff as before.

sentences.zh: 以征西將軍、雍州刺史張敬兒為護軍將軍，新除給事黃門侍郎蕭長懋為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhang Jinger, General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Yongzhou, was made General Who Protects the Army; Xiao Changmao, newly appointed Gentleman Attendant of the Yellow Gate, was made Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jinger, General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Yongzhou, was appointed General Who Protects the Army; Xiao Changmao, newly appointed Gentleman Attendant of the Yellow Gate, was appointed Inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，安南將軍、南豫州刺史邵陵王友薨。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the second month the Prince of Shaoling You, General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of South Yuzhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the second month Prince of Shaoling You, General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of South Yuzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the third month, the day guimao, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the third month, the day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，崇太傅為相國，總百揆，封十郡，為齊公，備九錫之禮，加璽紱遠游冠，位在諸王上，加相國綠綟綬，其驃騎大將軍、揚州牧、南徐州刺史如故。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day the Grand Preceptor was elevated to Chancellor of State, directing all affairs of government, enfeoffed with ten commanderies as Duke of Qi, granted the full rites of the Nine Bestowals, additionally given the imperial seal-cord and the Far Roaming cap, ranking above all princes, with a green cord for the Chancellor of State; he remained Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Governor of Yangzhou, and Inspector of South Xuzhou as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the Grand Preceptor was elevated to Chancellor of State, directing all affairs of government, enfeoffed with ten commanderies as Duke of Qi, granted the full rites of the Nine Bestowals, additionally given the imperial seal-cord and the Far Roaming cap, ranking above all princes, with a green cord for the Chancellor of State; he remained Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Governor of Yangzhou, and Inspector of South Xuzhou as before.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以中軍大將軍蕭賾為南豫州刺史、齊公世子，副貳相國，綠綟綬。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day Xiao Ze, Grand Central Army Commander, was made Inspector of South Yuzhou and heir of the Duke of Qi, deputy to the Chancellor of State, with a green cord.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Xiao Ze, Grand Central Army Commander, was appointed Inspector of South Yuzhou and heir of the Duke of Qi, deputy to the Chancellor of State, with a green cord.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，臨川王綽謀反，綽及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day Prince of Linchuan Chuo plotted rebellion; Chuo and his partisans were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Prince of Linchuan Chuo plotted rebellion; Chuo and his associates were all executed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以齊國初建，給錢五百萬，布五千匹，絹千匹。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, because the State of Qi was newly established, five million cash, five thousand bolts of cloth, and one thousand bolts of silk were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, because the State of Qi was newly established, five million cash, five thousand bolts of cloth, and one thousand bolts of silk were granted.

sentences.zh: 建元元年五月己未，殂于丹陽宮，時年十三。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the fifth month of the first year of Jianyuan he died in the Danyang Palace, aged thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the fifth month of the first year of Jianyuan he died in the Danyang Palace, aged thirteen.

sentences.zh: 諡曰順帝。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Emperor Shun.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Emperor Shun.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，葬于遂寧陵。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the sixth month he was buried at Suining Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the sixth month he was buried at Suining Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：聖王膺錄，自非接亂承微，則天曆不至也。

translations.literal: The historian says: When a sage king receives the register of rule, it is not unless he meets disorder and inherits a fragile age that the celestial mandate does not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: When a sage king receives the mandate, it is only after meeting disorder and inheriting a fragile age that the celestial ordination arrives.

sentences.zh: 自三、五以來，受命之主，莫不乘淪亡之極，然後符樂推之運。

translations.literal: From the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors onward, every ruler who received the mandate did so only after riding the extreme of ruin, and only then did the talisman and musical verification of the transfer of rule appear.
translations.idiomatic: From the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors onward, every ruler who received the mandate did so only at the furthest point of collapse, and only then did the talisman and musical verification of dynastic change appear.

sentences.zh: 水德遷謝，其來久矣，豈止於區區汝陰揖禪而已哉！

translations.literal: The transfer of the Water virtue had come long ago—how could it stop at the mere yielding of the throne at Ruyin!
translations.idiomatic: The transfer of the Water virtue had been long in coming—how could it be limited to the mere yielding of the throne at Ruyin!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual collation notes

sentences.zh: 字仲謀 元龜一八二同。

translations.literal: Courtesy name Zhongmou: Yuan gui 182 agrees.
translations.idiomatic: Courtesy name Zhongmou: Yuan gui 182 agrees.

sentences.zh: 南史、建康實錄、御覽一二八引作「字仲謨」。

translations.literal: The History of the Southern Dynasties, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Imperial Digest 128 cite "courtesy name Zhongmo."
translations.idiomatic: The History of the Southern Dynasties, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Imperial Digest 128 cite "courtesy name Zhongmo."

sentences.zh: 中書令衞將軍開府儀同三司撫軍將軍劉秉為尚書令加中軍將軍 按據李慈銘宋書札記、孫虨宋書考論，並參考南史宋本紀、本書袁粲傳、南齊書褚淵傳，「中書令」當作「尚書令」，「衞將軍」下，似脫「袁粲為中書監，領司徒，中書監褚淵為衞將軍，並」十九字。

translations.literal: Master of Writing, Guards General, Baimen equal to the Three Ministries, General Who Pacifies the Army Liu Bing made Director of the Masters of Writing and additionally Central Army Commander: According to Li Ciming's Notes on the Song History and Sun Ao's Studies on the Song History, and with reference to the annals of Song in the History of the Southern Dynasties, the biography of Yuan Can in this book, and the biography of Chu Yuan in the Book of Southern Qi, "Master of Writing" should read "Director of the Masters of Writing," and below "Guards General" it seems nineteen characters are missing: "Yuan Can was made Master of Writing and held concurrently Minister over the Masses; Chu Yuan was made Guards General, and."
translations.idiomatic: Master of Writing, Guards General, Baimen equal to the Three Ministries, General Who Pacifies the Army Liu Bing made Director of the Masters of Writing and additionally Central Army Commander: According to Li Ciming's Notes on the Song History and Sun Ao's Studies on the Song History, and with reference to the annals of Song in the History of the Southern Dynasties, the biography of Yuan Can in this book, and the biography of Chu Yuan in the Book of Southern Qi, "Master of Writing" should read "Director of the Masters of Writing," and below "Guards General" it seems nineteen characters are missing: "Yuan Can was made Master of Writing and held concurrently Minister over the Masses; Chu Yuan was made Guards General, and."

sentences.zh: 司徒袁粲鎮石頭 「司徒」各本作「司空」。

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses Yuan Can held Stone City: in all editions "Minister over the Masses" reads "Minister of Works."
translations.idiomatic: Minister over the Masses Yuan Can held Stone City: in all editions "Minister over the Masses" reads "Minister of Works."

sentences.zh: 按時蕭道成為司空，袁粲為司徒，見南齊書高祖紀，及本書袁粲傳。

translations.literal: At the time Xiao Daocheng was Minister of Works and Yuan Can was Minister over the Masses, as seen in the annals of the Founding Emperor in the Book of Southern Qi and the biography of Yuan Can in this book.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Xiao Daocheng was Minister of Works and Yuan Can was Minister over the Masses, as seen in the annals of the Founding Emperor in the Book of Southern Qi and the biography of Yuan Can in this book.

sentences.zh: 今據南史、建康實錄改正。

translations.literal: Now corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and the Veritable Record of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Now corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and the Veritable Record of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己酉 下有丙午。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, jiyou day: below it there is a bingwu day.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, jiyou day: below it there is a bingwu day.

sentences.zh: 按是月辛巳朔，初五日乙酉，二十六日丙午，二十九日己酉。

translations.literal: According to this, the first day of the month was xinsi; the fifth day was yiyou, the twenty-sixth day was bingwu, and the twenty-ninth day was jiyou.
translations.idiomatic: According to this, the first day of the month was xinsi; the fifth day was yiyou, the twenty-sixth day was bingwu, and the twenty-ninth day was jiyou.

sentences.zh: 己酉不當在丙午前。

translations.literal: Jiyou cannot stand before bingwu.
translations.idiomatic: The day jiyou cannot stand before the day bingwu.

sentences.zh: 建康實錄作乙酉，疑己酉是乙酉之譌。

translations.literal: The Veritable Record of Jiankang reads yiyou; presumably jiyou is a corruption of yiyou.
translations.idiomatic: The Veritable Record of Jiankang reads yiyou; presumably jiyou is a corruption of yiyou.

sentences.zh: 吳興太守沈文季討斬之 「沈文季」三朝本作「沈文李」，北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「沈文秀」。

translations.literal: Governor of Wuxing Shen Wenji attacked and beheaded him: the Three Dynasties editions read "Shen Wenli"; the Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, Hall edition, and Bureau edition read "Shen Wenxiu."
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Wuxing Shen Wenji attacked and beheaded him: the Three Dynasties editions read "Shen Wenli"; the Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, Hall edition, and Bureau edition read "Shen Wenxiu."

sentences.zh: 按沈文秀明帝世守青州，已為北魏所俘。

translations.literal: Shen Wenxiu in the reign of Emperor Ming guarded Qingzhou and had already been captured by the Northern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Wenxiu in the reign of Emperor Ming guarded Qingzhou and had already been captured by the Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 此吳興太守乃沈文季。

translations.literal: The Governor of Wuxing here is Shen Wenji.
translations.idiomatic: The Governor of Wuxing here is Shen Wenji.

sentences.zh: 南齊書沈文季傳可證。

translations.literal: This is confirmed by the biography of Shen Wenji in the Book of Southern Qi.
translations.idiomatic: This is confirmed by the biography of Shen Wenji in the Book of Southern Qi.

sentences.zh: 寧朔將軍北秦州刺史武都王楊文度進號征西將軍 「楊文度」各本並譌作「楊文慶」，據氐傳改。

translations.literal: General of Pacifying the North, Inspector of North Qinzhou, Prince of Wudu Yang Wendu advanced to General Who Conquers the West: all editions corrupt "Yang Wendu" as "Yang Wenqing"; corrected according to the biography of the Di.
translations.idiomatic: General of Pacifying the North, Inspector of North Qinzhou, Prince of Wudu Yang Wendu advanced to General Who Conquers the West: all editions corrupt "Yang Wendu" as "Yang Wenqing"; corrected according to the biography of the Di.

sentences.zh: 以江州刺史邵陵王友為安南將軍南豫州刺史「南豫州」各本並作「豫州」。

translations.literal: Made Inspector of South Yuzhou for the Prince of Shaoling You, General Who Pacifies the South: in all editions "South Yuzhou" reads "Yuzhou."
translations.idiomatic: Made Inspector of South Yuzhou for the Prince of Shaoling You, General Who Pacifies the South: in all editions "South Yuzhou" reads "Yuzhou."

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「豫州上當有『南』字。

translations.literal: Sun Ao's Studies on the Song History says: "The character 'South' should stand above 'Yuzhou.'"
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ao's Studies on the Song History says: "The character 'South' should stand above 'Yuzhou.'"

sentences.zh: 」按邵陵王友傳，時為南豫州刺史，孫說是，今補。

translations.literal: According to the biography of the Prince of Shaoling You, at the time he was Inspector of South Yuzhou; Sun's view is correct, and it is now supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: According to the biography of the Prince of Shaoling You, at the time he was Inspector of South Yuzhou; Sun's view is correct, and it is now supplemented.

sentences.zh: 凡十有四條 南史齊本紀及南齊書高帝紀並作「凡十七條」。

translations.literal: Fourteen articles in all: the annals of Qi in the History of the Southern Dynasties and the annals of the Founding Emperor in the Book of Southern Qi both read "seventeen articles."
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen articles in all: the annals of Qi in the History of the Southern Dynasties and the annals of the Founding Emperor in the Book of Southern Qi both read "seventeen articles."
